nodes.name: 06:30 Asia Kolkata
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 06:30 in the workflow timezone (Asia/Kolkata). The imported workflow is inactive until an owner reviews and activates it.

nodes.name: Refresh newsroom research
nodes.notes: Calls the API over the private Compose network. It does not select stories, invent an angle, or write a script.

nodes.name: Format neutral top 8
nodes.notes: Deterministic formatting only: score-sort, top eight, and neutral API-provided summaries. Editorial selection and angle remain human tasks.

nodes.name: Telegram explicitly enabled?
nodes.notes: Default is false. Set TELEGRAM_ENABLED=true and supply the bot token/chat ID only in infra/.env to take the true branch.

nodes.name: Split for Telegram limit
nodes.notes: Telegram messages are limited to 4096 characters; leave headroom and send ordered chunks.

nodes.name: Optional Telegram delivery
nodes.notes: No credential is embedded. After import, create/select an n8n Telegram API credential here. Leave TELEGRAM_ENABLED=false until that is done.

nodes.name: Digest ready for review
nodes.notes: Normal default endpoint. Open this node's output to copy the digest.
